deployments_detail.use: Kaohsiung Port No.7 container terminal (Evergreen-operated) is AI-enabled with automated equipment and 5G, targeting 4.5M TEU annual capacity toward full automation
AI autonomous navigation system for container ships [Samsung]

Trans-Pacific autonomous navigation: Samsung Autonomous Ship (SAS) system fused radar, GPS, AIS and camera data with AI to run a 15,000-TEU Evergreen boxship from Oakland to Kaohsiung (~10,000 km), performing 104 guidance operations and 224 automated control actions without crew intervention, analyzing weather/route every 3 hours and optimizing economical speed. [Samsung Heavy Industries (SAS)]
deployments_detail.value: 10,000 km voyage; 104 guidance operations and 224 automated control actions without crew intervention

deployments_detail.use: Terminal 7 at Kaohsiung Port, Taiwan's first fully automated container terminal: 60 automated rail-mounted gantry cranes, remote-controlled quay cranes, unmanned vehicles, IoT/5G network and an AI-coordinated terminal operating system (TOS) plus real-time power monitoring to run yard operations.
deployments_detail.value: 60 automated rail-mounted cranes operating without workers

deployments_detail.use: ClassNK-NAPA GREEN eco-efficiency software deployed on chartered container vessels for real-time performance monitoring, voyage routing, speed and trim optimization to cut fuel consumption, using a Dynamic Performance Model (99.6% accuracy). [NAPA / ClassNK (NAPA GREEN)]
deployments_detail.value: expected 4-6% fuel consumption reduction in trials; performance model 99.6% accuracy

deployments_detail.use: Navis StowMan Control Center, Distributed Services and loading computers for vessel stowage planning across the fleet, using stability/stress calculations, slot definitions and advanced lashing/optimization to improve cargo capacity utilization and sailing safety (adopted after the EVER SMART incident review). [Navis / Kaleris (StowMan)]
Signed agreement to deploy a new AI-powered vessel and fleet/fuel management digital platform to optimize fleet operations and fuel consumption.

In-house ship fuel efficiency management system that uses AI-based intelligent scheduling to optimize routes and reduce fuel consumption across the owned fleet, part of Evergreen's energy and emissions management (reported in its sustainability/CSR reporting).

Strategic AI-integration mandate under new leadership targeting predictive maintenance for vessels, optimized route planning for fuel efficiency, and AI-enhanced cargo management to improve port turnaround.

GreenX digital booking platform uses AI to calculate container slot (space) prices in real time based on demand/competition, with guardrails preventing illogical (zero/negative) quotes, letting customers get instant quotes and book capacity immediately, replacing email/phone processes. [BlueX Trade]
